words.prose: {{ar:تَصْلِيَةُ}} ({{tr:taṣliyatu}}) turns burning into a nominal punishment item: not a finite action with an overt agent, but an assigned process coordinated with the prior consequence. The received nominative keeps it coordinate with 56:93, while the genitive variant only clarifies the alternate dependency pressure rather than replacing the local parse. As a Form II verbal noun, it keeps causative pressure, so the scene is imposed fire-exposure rather than voluntary warming, generic combustion, or devotional prayer language. Its construct relation with {{ar:جَحِيمٍ}} ({{tr:jaḥīmin}}) fuses process and fire into one mechanism, while the rare masdar form makes the process itself the listed destination-like consequence. The boundary also escalates from the prior scalding-liquid reception in 56:93 to imposed fire-exposure here, and the same burning/fire pairing belongs to a wider punishment formula (69:31, 37:163, 83:16). The heavy onset and doubled Form II pressure make that causation audible before the phrase lands on the fire noun.

topics.headline: construct chain fuses burning and fire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fire is bound inside the noun phrase as the specifying domain of burning, not added afterward as a loose location.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks a forced iḍāfa relation in which the verbal noun governs the following genitive noun.

topics.reason: V4 separates the local fire-exposure branch from prayer, warming, and kindling branches, and the local construct with the fire noun selects imposed exposure.

topics.reason: The root range includes prayer and blessing branches, but the aligned Form II verbal noun in this construct selects the fire-exposure branch.

words.prose: {{ar:جَحِيمٍ}} ({{tr:jaḥīmin}}) completes the construct by naming the fire that specifies the burning process. Its genitive role keeps the fire inside the phrase as source, medium, and domain, while its indefiniteness keeps the word qualitative: fierce fire, not only the familiar definite fire-name. The root image is not generic flame but stoked blazing intensity, so the ayah closes by moving from the scalding-liquid heat of 56:93 to a final fire-word whose sound, position, and meaning land the punishment sequence on intensified fire itself. The final term also joins a wider punishment vocabulary: the burning/fire pairing has parallels at 69:31, 37:163, and 83:16, while the group-identity pressure reaches back to the left-side group named in 56:9.

topics.headline: stoked blazing over generic fire

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal construction joins تَصْلِيَةُ (ص ل ي) to جَحِيمٍ (ج ح م).
baseline_models.mechanism: The first noun names an imposed encounter with fire, while the genitive noun specifies a fiercely blazing medium; the phrase therefore presents punishment as direct thermal exposure rather than a mere location label.

activation_trace.role: Encountering fire, entering it, and suffering its heat supply the core event; the verbal noun makes that encounter the administered process.
The parallel mapped inventory confirms fire-contact, burning, and severe heat as the operative range rather than leaving the root at a generic action.
A fire at full blaze and intense heat specifies both the medium and the extremity of the exposure.

changed_reading.before: A compact mention of punishment in hellfire.
changed_reading.after: An administered process of being brought into direct encounter with an intensely blazing fire.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَصْلِيَةُ carries a branch in which fire kindles, roasts, or works upon an object, and جَحِيمٍ supplies the extreme heat.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heat is not only the place encountered but an active material agent: as fire roasts or straightens what is held over it, the blazing fire subjects its recipient to a sustained heat-process.

activation_trace.role: Kindling, roasting, and straightening by fire supply a material process in which heat actively works upon what is exposed.
The fiercely blazing fire intensifies that material process and prevents it from becoming a neutral craft analogy.

changed_reading.before: The person is simply placed in a fiery destination.
changed_reading.after: The person undergoes an active, sustained heat-processing in the blaze; this is exploratory and does not imply beneficial correction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier protected writing has a regulated contact boundary: it is kept under cover and touch is associated with purification. Against that scene, تَصْلِيَةُ becomes the denier's inverse contact regime, compulsory and unshielded contact with a destructive medium.

activation_trace.role: Protective concealment supplies a guarded enclosure, establishing that one consequential object is shielded from indiscriminate access.
Contact as receiving an effect makes touch consequential rather than merely spatial and supplies the regulated-contact side of the contrast.
Purity and removal of defilement supply the qualifying condition attached to the earlier contact.
Direct encounter with fire supplies the compulsory contact that reverses the guarded and qualified touch scene.
The fully blazing medium makes the later contact injurious and unshielded.

structural_cues: The window first restricts touch to the protected writing in 56:78-79, then assigns fire-exposure to the deniers after their classification in 56:92.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guarded concealment, qualified touch, and later fire-contact; I infer an inverse contact architecture. A live alternative is that the two contact scenes are adjacent themes without a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: تَصْلِيَةُ is only an isolated act of burning.
changed_reading.after: It is compulsory, unprotected contact with the blaze, the destructive inverse of guarded contact qualified by purification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The scene tracks life to a bodily endpoint, exposes the observers' failed sight, and challenges them to reverse the departure. The later nominal outcomes can therefore be read as what takes custody beyond that irreversible threshold, with تَصْلِيَةُ naming a transfer into fire-exposure rather than a static far-off locale.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at an endpoint supplies the terminal boundary at which the outcome sequence begins.
The throat as the passage of breath and food makes that endpoint bodily and transitional.
Ordinary eyesight supplies the capacity explicitly negated, marking the transfer as present yet inaccessible to the witnesses.
Return to the prior state supplies the reversal that the challenge declares unavailable.
Being brought into fire-contact supplies the post-threshold destination process.
The blaze gives that transfer a concrete thermal terminus.

structural_cues: 56:83-87 pauses at the throat, contrasts looking with not seeing, and repeats the challenge to return the departing life before 56:88-94 distributes outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reached bodily limit, unseen nearness, failed return, and then class-specific outcomes; I infer that the outcome nouns describe custody across the threshold. A live alternative places the fire-exposure at a later stage with no immediate transfer implication.

changed_reading.before: The fire is a remote destination mentioned after death.
changed_reading.after: The verbal noun marks the irreversible transfer from the death-threshold into an administered encounter with the blaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two favorable outcomes combine relief, sheltered garden, good condition, and safety. The third outcome reverses each axis: instead of rest inside protective abundance, the recipient is exposed to consuming heat. جَحِيمٍ is thus not merely hotter; it is the anti-shelter and anti-rest assigned by the same classification sequence.

activation_trace.role: Rest and relief supply the favorable outcome's bodily condition, which fire-exposure reverses into sustained distress.
A garden enclosed and screened by growth supplies protective habitation, against which exposure to blaze functions as anti-shelter.
Well-being and favorable condition supply the positive state systematically inverted by the deniers' outcome.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the second favorable outcome's governing condition.
Suffering direct fire-contact supplies the bodily reversal of relief and safety.
The intensely blazing environment supplies the exposed anti-habitation opposed to the sheltered garden.

structural_cues: The repeated وَأَمَّا and إِن كَانَ frames of 56:88, 56:90, and 56:92 distribute three corresponding outcome blocks in 56:89, 56:91, and 56:93-94.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel class frames followed by relief, safety, or heat; I infer that the third block is built as a point-by-point environmental reversal. A live alternative treats each block as independent reward or punishment vocabulary without exact inversion.

changed_reading.before: جَحِيمٍ contributes only greater heat to the punishment.
changed_reading.after: The blaze is the classified anti-shelter: exposed heat and distress in exact contrast to relief, protected garden, well-being, and safety.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, نُزُل names what is prepared for an arriver and حَمِيم supplies heated liquid. Coordinated تَصْلِيَةُ then becomes the second component of a hostile reception: an arrival allotment that moves from scalding provision to direct blazing exposure.

activation_trace.role: Prepared provision for one who arrives supplies the reception frame into which the following fire-exposure is coordinated.
Hot water supplies the first thermal component of the reception and links ingestible heat to the following environmental heat.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yüzdeki etkiyi özellikle iç sıcaklığın doğurduğu ateşli harlanma olarak belirler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, öfkenin yüzdeki etkisini görünüşün türünü belirtmeden genel biçimde anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yoğun öfkenin yüzde görünür bir değişiklik oluşturmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal komşunun genel yüz etkisini ateş ve sıcaklık görüntüsüyle daraltır. Bu özel görüntünün bulunmadığı her öfkeli yüz değişikliği odak dala girmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, öfkenin özellikle yüzde oluşturduğu ateşli görünüşü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yüzdeki belirli sonucu zorunlu kılmadan öfkenin kendisini tutuşan ateşe benzetir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal öfkenin yükselişini ateşin tutuşup büyümesine benzetir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın zorunlu katılımcısı yüz ve onda beliren değişimdir; komşu dalda merkezde olan öfkenin kendi hareketi ve yoğunluğudur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bütün yüzün ateş gibi harlanmasını öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal öfke ve zorlanma yüzünden özellikle gözün kızarmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal öfkenin baş bölgesinde oluşturduğu sıcak ve kızıl görünüşü işler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın alanı yüz ve ateşli harlanma, komşu dalın alanı ise göz ve kızarmadır; katılımcı ile görünür sonuç aynı değildir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Genel yüz etkisi, tutuşan öfke ve öfkeden kızaran göz en yakın sınırları verir. Burun hareketi yalnız ayrı bir öfke belirtisidir; gerçek ateş, sıcak hava, gözyaşı, kan ve boyun alanındaki adaylar çekirdekle yer değiştiremez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü doğrudan utanma duygusu az olan kişiyi niteler. Geçici dal çerçevesindeki az utanma anlamı, bunu daha ağır bir utanmazlık ya da başka bir huyla karıştırmadan doğru biçimde karşılar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Niteleme yalnız utanma duygusunun azlığını bildirir; göz hastalığı, dar huyluluk, hırs, küstahlık veya kavgacılık zorunlu değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın kişi nitelemesiyle sınırlıdır ve komşu dallardaki davranış, göz veya ateş anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Utanma duygusu az olan kişiyi niteler; tek başına kavgacılık, kötü huy veya bütünüyle utanmazlık bildirmez.

facets.statement: Kişinin utanma duygusu olağandan azdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Dal, tek başına kullanılan ve kişideki utanma duygusunun azlığını bildiren bir nitelemeden oluşur.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık, kişiyi utanma duygusu az oluşuyla niteler.

concept_gloss.text: utanma duygusu az olan kişi
concept_gloss.applicability: Kişiyi yalnız utanma duygusunun düşük derecesi bakımından niteleyen çekirdeği karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kişi niteliğini ve utanma duygusunun azlığını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin utanma eğiliminin zayıflığı doğal bir cümle içinde anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin az utanması yönündeki dereceyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal cinsiyet belirtmeden yalnız utanma duygusunun azlığını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle bir kadının atılgan, sert dilli ve kavgaya veya kötülüğe hazır oluşunu da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kişinin utanma duygusunun az olması yönünde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal az utanmaya cinsiyet, atılganlık ve kavgacılık özelliklerini ekler. Odak dal bu ek davranışları gerektirmeyen daha yalın bir kişi niteliğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal içsel bir utanma eksikliğini kişi niteliği olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir başkasına karşı cüretli, fazla içli dışlı veya nazlı davranma eylemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Az utanma, kişiyi başkasına karşı çekinmeden davranmaya yöneltebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir huy derecesidir; komşu dal ise belirli bir kişiye yönelen davranıştır. Çekinmez davranış az utanmadan doğabilir, ancak onu zorunlu olarak göstermez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişinin utanma duygusunun azlığını belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişinin dar, geçimsiz veya kötü huylu oluşunu belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişiyi toplum içinde olumsuz değerlendirilen bir huyla niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Utanma duygusunun azlığı ile dar veya kötü huyluluk ayrı kişilik özellikleridir; biri ötekini zorunlu kılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Az utanmaya atılganlık ekleyen dal, çekinmez davranış ve dar huyluluk en yararlı sınırları verir. Genel huy, gösteriş, taşkın sevinç, kötü huyun başka adları ve böbürlenme adayları yalnız geniş davranış alanını paylaşır.
